text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 24, April 11, 1936 ]
EXPENDITURE OF P75,000 OF THE 5 PER CENT REQUIRED SAVINGS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF
Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Justice and of the Secretary of Finance and pursuant to the
provisions of section three of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five, I hereby authorize the expenditure by the
Director of Prisons with the approval of the Secretary of Justice of the sum of seventy-five thousand pesos of
the five per cent required savings of the Department of Justice for the construction of buildings and other
necessary structures, for the purchase of the necessary structures, for the purchase of the necessary equipment
and supplies, and for salaries and such other expenses as may be deemed necessary to carry out the provisions
of Act Numbered Three thousand nine hundred and eighty-four which authorizes the establishment of a new
insular prison outside the City of Manila, pending the appropriation of the necessary fund for this purpose by
the National Assembly.
Done at the City of Manila, this eleventh day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-six, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the first.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
